sentences.text: Acidaminococcus intestini belongs to the family Acidaminococcaceae, order Selenomonadales, class Negativicutes, phylum Firmicutes.
Negativicutes show the double-membrane system of Gram-negative bacteria, although their chromosomal backbone is closely related to that of Gram-positive bacteria of the phylum Firmicutes.
A complete genome sequence was reported for a clinical strain of this species.
A proteome analysis reported that about 7% of the A. intestini proteome is closely related to sequences from the phylum Proteobacteria, and identified key proteins of outer membrane biogenesis.
